fields.description: Issue features an extended exposé and follow-up reporting on conditions at the Miami Retreat, including allegations of patient abuse, questionable billing practices involving county charges, and calls for investigation; includes coverage of Disabled American Veterans Post No. 10 urging action by Gov. Warren and Crime Commission Director Dan Sullivan. Also reports a bulletin questioning Jackson Memorial Hospital intake records in a death case, discusses oil drilling activity west of Miami near Everglades City and the Trail (Tamiami Trail), argues for pensions for unemployed veterans of both World Wars, critiques proposed water-rate increases and local politics, and runs a piece on fraudulent spiritualist/medium practices and related commercial suppliers. Contains regular columns and local commentary plus advertisements and entertainment/nightlife listings.
